visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character with short brown hair, wearing black glasses and a beige turtleneck, stands in a brightly lit indoor office. She holds a small black clip-on microphone near her mouth, gesturing with her right hand while speaking directly to the camera. Behind her, a white wall features a clinic logo 'DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC' and shelves with various skincare products. (2) The scene cuts to a high-angle shot of various foods including almonds, chickpeas, avocado, and chocolate arranged around a central graphic labeled 'Mg Magnesium'. (3) The visual shifts to a close-up of green leafy vegetables in a supermarket crate, followed by a close-up of round chocolate truffles and then a bowl of raw quinoa grains. (4) The woman returns to the frame, holding up two fingers, followed by a B-roll shot of raw red meat, shrimp, and mushrooms on a dark background with the word 'Zinc' written on a chalkboard. (5) The scene transitions to a medical animation of the human digestive system highlighting the intestines, followed by a macro close-up of a person's skin showing visible pores and acne. (6) A chalkboard graphic appears with the word 'PROBIOTIC' and a drawing of a capsule. (7) The video concludes with a static graphic displaying clinic contact information, including a phone number and addresses in Traditional Chinese.
